clue.text: Slow starter and touchy, I'm easily knocked down

indicators.note: the starter of the word Slow is its opening letter, so only that is taken

parts.note: kittle is a Scots and dialect word meaning ticklish or touchy

explanation.surface: A slow-starting, thin-skinned person admits to being a pushover.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue speaks in the first person as the object itself, a pin set up in the pub game and bowled over by a ball.
explanation.definitionFit: A skittle is a wooden pin whose whole purpose is to be bowled over.

clue.text: Essential person to front 1

definitions.meaning: the most important figure, on whom an organisation depends
the leading pin, standing at the front of the set of skittles

explanation.walkthrough: '1' is the skittle answer: the pin at the head of the triangle has its own name.
explanation.definitionFit: The key pin at the front of a skittle formation lends its name to any indispensable person.

clue.text: Great man gets money without acknowledgment

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so one piece wraps around the other

parts.note: tin is old slang for money
ta is British informal thanks, an acknowledgment

explanation.surface: A great man takes cash and never says thank you.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like 'lacking', but here it carries its old sense of outside, so the money wraps around the thanks.
explanation.definitionFit: A titan is a person of enormous stature, after the giant gods of Greek myth.

clue.text: In church it's part of the collection, a bird (probably an eagle)

indicators.note: part of says some consecutive letters are taken from inside the words that follow

parts.note: the ern or erne is the sea eagle

explanation.surface: Church takings are shared with a bird, most likely an eagle.
explanation.walkthrough: Church lecterns are traditionally carved as an eagle with spread wings, so the bracket hints at the answer as well as the bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A lectern is the reading stand found in a church, used for the Bible.

clue.text: Prevent broadcasting of advertisement for cake

parts.note: to jam a signal is to block its broadcast
a puff is a piece of promotional praise or advertisement

explanation.surface: Someone blocks the airing of a commercial for a pastry.
explanation.definitionFit: A jam puff is a puff-pastry cake filled with jam.

clue.text: Both of us fools? Take it as read

parts.note: an ass is a fool, used here loosely for the plural
you and me: U is text shorthand for you, plus ME
you and me: U is text shorthand for you, plus ME

explanation.surface: Someone sighs that you and they are both idiots.
explanation.walkthrough: It plays on the saying that to assume makes an ASS of U and ME.
explanation.definitionFit: To take something as read is to suppose it true without proof.

clue.text: What I do with a sock will be a 29

definitions.text: What I do with a sock will be a 29

parts.words: What I do with a sock will be a 29
parts.note: literally, inserting one's foot into a sock; idiomatically, a social blunder, which is what the answer '29' is

explanation.walkthrough: '29' is the answer FAUX PAS, a tactless blunder.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to say or do something tactless, a social blunder.

clue.text: Identifies as criminal: 11 part 1 them when…

definitions.meaning: to point the finger at someone, slang for naming them to police
the first part of the answer at 11 is CROSS; people cross these when speaking insincerely, continuing into the next clue

explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis runs on into the next clue: you cross your fingers when talking insincerely.
explanation.definitionFit: To finger someone is slang for informing on them; crossing one's fingers excuses a fib.

clue.text: … insincerely making it difficult to talk

definitions.meaning: literally, with the tongue pressed into the side of the mouth

explanation.walkthrough: The leading ellipsis links back to the previous clue.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means ironically, and a tongue lodged against the jaw would hamper speech.

clue.text: See 7
Staurolite annoyed Oliver and Sharon

parts.note: cross means angry or annoyed
Oliver Stone the film director and Sharon Stone the actress share this surname

explanation.surface: A mineral sample upset two Hollywood figures.
explanation.definitionFit: Staurolite is a mineral whose crystals twin in a cross shape, hence its common name.

clue.text: Rely on another for money and cake

definitions.meaning: to live off others, cadging cash

explanation.definitionFit: To sponge is to cadge from others; a sponge is also a light cake.

clue.text: Setter's included in joke about tree reversing handicap

annotationWithheld.why: Setter's included in joke about tree reversing handicap (5,3): GAMMY LEG appears to be GAG round A + MY inside reversed ELM, but nothing supplies the A unless 'about' does, and then the two insertions share one indicator 'included in'; no sourced parse found
annotationWithheld.clue: Setter's included in joke about tree reversing handicap

clue.text: Not another pawnbroker nearly put to death?

indicators.note: nearly says the slang word is cut short of its end

parts.note: uncle is old slang for a pawnbroker
hanged means executed on the gallows

explanation.surface: A moneylender was almost executed, and no one new replaced him.
explanation.definitionFit: Unchanged means still the same, not turned into something else.

clue.text: Providing us with home help with a knee problem?

definitions.text: Providing us with home help with a knee problem?

parts.words: Providing us with home help with a knee problem?
parts.note: a domestic servant, whose name is also given to a kneeling-induced swelling of the knee

explanation.walkthrough: Housemaid's knee is bursitis caused by long kneeling while scrubbing floors.
explanation.definitionFit: A housemaid is a domestic servant, giving home help; housemaid's knee is a knee ailment.

clue.text: Computer operator not a man?

definitions.meaning: the hand-held pointing device that operates a computer
from the taunt 'are you a man or a ...?', the timid alternative

explanation.definitionFit: A mouse is the pointing device for a computer and the timid creature contrasted with a man.

clue.text: It's nearer the sun — that's some evenings from the East

definitions.text: It's nearer the sun — that's some evenings from the East

parts.words: It's nearer the sun — that's some evenings from the East
parts.note: a planet closer to the sun than Earth, seen as the evening star at times and as a morning star rising in the east

explanation.walkthrough: The planet alternates between appearing after sunset and before sunrise.
explanation.definitionFit: Venus orbits inside Earth's orbit and shines as both evening and morning star.

clue.text: About time symphony was produced as 17's work

indicators.note: about says the symphony wraps round the single letter

parts.note: the Eroica is Beethoven's Third Symphony

explanation.surface: Around the hour a famous symphony was performed as a love goddess's oeuvre.
explanation.walkthrough: '17' is VENUS, the goddess of love, whose 'work' is erotic.
explanation.definitionFit: Erotica is sexual literature or art, fittingly the province of the love goddess.

clue.text: The Life of Wallace and Gromit?

definitions.text: The Life of Wallace and Gromit?

parts.words: The Life of Wallace and Gromit?
parts.note: the clay-figure duo are brought to life frame by frame, so this is what gives them life

explanation.walkthrough: Wallace and Gromit are claymation characters from British film studio Aardman.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both liveliness and the technique of making models appear to move.

clue.text: Complaint of girl about US city

indicators.note: about tells us the girl's name goes round the city

parts.note: Maria is a girl's name
LA is Los Angeles

explanation.surface: A woman grumbles about an American city.
explanation.definitionFit: A complaint is an illness, and malaria is a mosquito-borne disease.

clue.text: Girl ruined by endless vacation

indicators.note: ruined says the letters are wrecked and rearranged
endless says the final letter is dropped from the word

explanation.surface: A young woman's holiday is spoiled because it never finishes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless' takes the N off VACATION, leaving VACATIO, which 'ruined by' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: Octavia is a girl's name.

clue.text: Join the ranks, darling!

parts.note: read as a drill command, 'take your place in line, sweetheart', which as a phrase means become smitten

explanation.walkthrough: Fall in is the parade-ground order to line up, and 'darling' supplies the endearment.
explanation.definitionFit: To become enamoured of someone, punning on the military order to line up.

clue.text: Go up with no thought for the consequences — German measels

parts.note: rose is the past of rise, went up

parts.words: with no thought for the consequences
parts.note: rash means reckless

explanation.surface: Someone rises impetuously, then catches a childhood illness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Measels' is the clue's own spelling of measles.
explanation.definitionFit: Rose rash is an old name for rubella, which produces a pink skin eruption.

clue.text: Place to see and hear girl

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look or see

indicators.note: hear says the girl's name is taken for its sound only

parts.note: Kate is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A spot for seeing and listening to a young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: To place something is to locate it, find where it is.

clue.text: Clay formed on top of unknown flower part

indicators.note: formed says the letters are shaped into a new order

parts.note: x is the mathematician's unknown

explanation.surface: Moulded clay sits on top of a mystery bloom.
explanation.definitionFit: The calyx is the ring of sepals at the base of a flower.

clue.text: Sharpshooter's line in headgear at old city

indicators.note: in puts the line inside the hat word

parts.note: tile is slang for a hat
a rail is a line, as of railway
Ur is the ancient city of Mesopotamia

explanation.surface: A marksman's line of fire passes through a hat at an ancient city.
explanation.walkthrough: TILE is old slang for a hat; the definition's possessive matches the 's of 'sharpshooter is'.
explanation.definitionFit: A tirailleur was a French skirmisher or sharpshooter.

clue.text: See 28 and 22
Conspiring to avoid chilblains?

definitions.meaning: literally, having the hand inside a warm covering

explanation.walkthrough: Chilblains are itchy swellings caused by cold, which a glove prevents.
explanation.definitionFit: Hand in glove means in close collusion; a gloved hand stays warm.

clue.text: Message about refined parent's bloomer

indicators.note: about says the message wraps round the refined letter

parts.note: a fax is a transmitted message
U means upper-class, refined
pa's, the parent's

explanation.surface: A note about a posh parent's flowering plant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bloomer' is a blunder, not a flower; U is the old label for upper-class usage.
explanation.definitionFit: A bloomer is a blunder, and a faux pas is a social gaffe.
